name: vllm-rocm-halo-wheel
description: vLLM wheel built from AMD's ROCm/vllm `gfx11` branch (gfx1151-tuned kernels: W4A16 prefill BLOCK_N, GDN prefill shape-keyed config, unquantized-weight stride padding off the gfx11x 4096B cliff). Built on the same rocm/vllm 7.13 / gfx1151 base as the upstream-main wheel, packaged FROM-scratch (.whl + resolved rocm requirements). Incremental via persistent ccache mount. Consumed by the vllm-rocm-halo assembler (the DEFAULT halo line; renamed from vllm-rocm-halo-gfx11). Parallel to the upstream-main vllm-rocm-halo-main (which carries DiffusionGemma); gfx11 trades DiffusionGemma for AMD's gfx1151 perf kernels + keeps FusedMoE.tp_size so AWQ MoE loads without the RoutedExperts regression.
